authority.interpretation: Authorizes VW-E1 under the uniquely displayed VW-R1 contract only. VW-E2 and all later events remain unsigned.

corpus.held_out_rule: Held-out bytes and labels may not tune thresholds, prompts, models, or rules. Their first scored use is VW-E7 after code, contract, configuration, dependency, and prompt hashes are sealed.
known_exclusions: A challenge-only specimen lacks raw pre-analyst Markdown and cannot score formatting improvement.
No second independent real page-map-poison family is available.
VW-H03 has no analyst output and is visual/raw-only.
VW-H02 has no current fidelity verdict; that field remains UNREAD until measured.
Held bundles with human repair state are not training inputs.

identity_and_invalidation.page_namespace: Source PDF pages are 1-based. Asset filename page IDs remain separately recorded as 0-based.
identity_and_invalidation.coordinates: Canonical PDF points plus normalized page fractions. Tiles are compute windows, never region identity.
identity_and_invalidation.report_id: SHA-256 over canonical UTF-8 JSON with report_id omitted; keys sorted and compact separators.
rules: Unreadable or mismatched source SHA invalidates the entire report as UNREAD.
Manifest or manifest-source SHA change invalidates the source/bundle/page-map join.
Markdown SHA change invalidates spans, text results, pair results, and phase metrics that consume it.
Asset-inventory SHA change invalidates visual and pair results.
Contract, configuration, code, dependency, engine, or prompt-byte hash change invalidates every inferred result that consumed it.
A stale human disposition remains historical and never transfers to a descendant region or report.

result_contract.rule: Machine evidence is immutable. Human disposition is a separate append-only record bound to report_id, region_id, and base_result_sha256. A disposition does not edit a document, apply a repair, change fidelity, or authorize a gate.

witness_truth.native_pdf_text: fidelity witness when the source hash, page, rectangle, extraction method, and text hash are recorded
witness_truth.embedded_or_correlated_ocr: untrusted agreement; correlation must be recorded
witness_truth.empty_extraction: Observed empty extraction only; it does not prove that the region contains no text
witness_truth.omission: always omitted-candidate until a human disposition; never machine-confirmed omitted
unread_conditions: model output length/truncation without complete coverage
no usable native text and OCR not run
ambiguous or correlated evidence that cannot be bounded

metric_contract.name: declared_page_pixel_coverage
metric_contract.numerator: valid rendered page pixels covered by at least one declared base tile
metric_contract.denominator: valid rendered page pixels on attempted readable pages
metric_contract.conditions: Frozen render DPI, CropBox, rotation, tiling, overlap, and fusion configuration. Any unread page is counted separately, never clean.

metric_contract.name: region_visual_support
metric_contract.numerator: evaluable source regions with source-conditioned output-asset support
metric_contract.conditions: Stratify by region class and relationship cardinality; report ambiguity and UNREAD separately.

metric_contract.name: native_text_survival
metric_contract.numerator: eligible native-source text windows found in the exact raw-Marker span
metric_contract.denominator: eligible native-source text windows in the source region
metric_contract.conditions: Clean/native witness only; denominator zero means UNREAD.

metric_contract.name: ocr_text_agreement
metric_contract.numerator: eligible independent-OCR windows agreeing with the exact raw-Marker span
metric_contract.denominator: eligible independent-OCR windows in the source region
metric_contract.conditions: Agreement, not fidelity; record engine lineage and alignment residual.

metric_contract.name: convert_text_survival
metric_contract.numerator: source-PDF witness windows surviving into raw Marker Markdown
metric_contract.conditions: Never combined with analyst survival. Images receive zero text-survival credit.

metric_contract.name: analyst_text_survival
metric_contract.numerator: raw-Marker windows surviving into analyst Markdown
metric_contract.conditions: Never referenced to source PDF. Denominator zero means UNREAD, not 1.0.

metric_contract.name: format_contract_admission
metric_contract.numerator: admitted proposals with protected spans, ordered assets, balanced structure, and content equivalence all intact
metric_contract.conditions: Report rejected raw fallbacks separately; a false admission is a red negative control.

metric_contract.name: bench_task_success
metric_contract.numerator: declared evidence-review tasks completed without hidden context or accessibility blocker
metric_contract.conditions: Stratify keyboard, zoom, viewport, theme, long-label, CJK, conflict, and UNREAD cases.

semantic_validation_law.schema_limit: JSON Schema validation is necessary but cannot prove sibling equality, exact arithmetic ratios, computed hashes, duplicate raw JSON keys after a permissive parse, or cross-split byte identity.
semantic_validation_law.required_probe: Before COMPLETE, reject duplicate raw members, recompute every ratio and hash, require numerator <= denominator, verify exact event/revision binding, and prove no source or bundle binding crosses the sealed split.
semantic_validation_law.self_attestation_rule: A boolean such as identical, equal, corresponds, or source_hash_match is evidence only after the same probe recomputes its predicate and a negative control is rejected.

privacy_and_retention.public_repository: Schemas, redacted case census, hashes of private manifests, and contract prose only.
privacy_and_retention.private_manifest: Local gitignored metadata; no source copies, crops, or OCR text.
privacy_and_retention.full_page_rasters: Ephemeral; one page at a time; delete on success or failure at event close.
privacy_and_retention.region_crops: Ephemeral by default; persist zero raw crops through VW-E4.
privacy_and_retention.captured_native_or_ocr_text: Ephemeral by default; sidecars retain hash, method, engine/version, geometry, and counts only.
privacy_and_retention.metadata_sidecars: Create-once, local-only, outside source, bundle, repository, anchor, held, pending, and vault.
privacy_and_retention.cloud: Denied by default. A later per-run human consent must name exact case IDs, bytes/fields leaving the machine, endpoint, resolved model/version, retention, cost, and expiry.
privacy_and_retention.logs: No absolute private paths, raw crop bytes, inline base64, source text, OCR text, credentials, or provider keys.
privacy_and_retention.purge: Every event exit proves ephemeral scratch deletion. Existing source PDFs and bundles are never purge targets.

resource_contract.page_working_set: one rendered page at a time
resource_contract.gpu_rule: Fail closed if the named mutex cannot be acquired or measured. Record wait time, hold time, engine PID, pre/peak/post VRAM, and unload result.
resource_contract.dependency_rule: Every worker and browser runner uses an isolated pinned environment. Never install into marker-env. Record interpreter, package-lock, native-library, model-weight, prompt, and configuration hashes.
resource_contract.render_rule: Do not request xrefs=True. Render once at the event-packet DPI; page/readability failure is UNREAD.
resource_contract.model_completion_rule: Record finish reason. A length/token ceiling or missing finish reason is truncated/UNREAD.

allowed: Read source, manifest, raw Markdown, analyst variants, and asset bytes.
Create contract/schema files in this event.
In later signed events, write report-only scratch outputs and create-once metadata sidecars outside operational roots.
forbidden_through_vw_e8: Modify source PDF, bundle Markdown, assets, manifest, repair ledger, analyst journal, event stream, lever files, audit mode, anchor, held, pending, staging, vault, or session clocks.
Call a mutating Repair Bench POST endpoint.
Apply a repair, change a fidelity verdict, hold, ship, publish, reconvert, reanalyze, or promote a threshold into a gate.
Upload document, crop, OCR, or Markdown bytes without a separate exact per-run human consent.

event_exit_rule: Every VW-E1 through VW-E8 receipt conforms to visual-witness-event-receipt-v1.schema.json, includes a same-check negative control and independent verifier, and ends with next_event_authority=UNSIGNED.
